mapper.select: SELECT FROM data_operation WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM data_operation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('PREPARED','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM data_operation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('PREPARED','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') AND operation_type IN #{type}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM data_operation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND operation_type='CLEAR_ALL_RECORDS' AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED')
mapper.update: UPDATE data_operation SET status=#{operation.status}, sealed_content_policy=#{operation.sealedContentPolicy}, total_items=#{operation.totalItems}, processed_items=#{operation.processedItems}, failed_items=#{operation.failedItems}, confirmation_nonce_hash=#{operation.confirmationNonceHash}, confirmation_expires_at=#{operation.confirmationExpiresAt}, artifact_token=#{operation.artifactToken}, artifact_expires_at=#{operation.artifactExpiresAt}, failure_code=#{operation.failureCode}, confirmed_at=#{operation.confirmedAt}, started_at=#{operation.startedAt}, completed_at=#{operation.completedAt}, updated_at=#{operation.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{operation.id} AND user_id=#{operation.userId} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
